svg.title: Goal folder
svg.desc: Fictional goal folder docs/specs/password-link/: Spec writes SPEC.md; Seal writes PLAN.md, REVIEW.md and PROGRESS.md; ha writes runs.jsonl. REVIEW.md holds the review plan and summarizes and points to the Spar records. Spar's review rounds (01-candidate/) and gate (gate.json) stay in docs/reviews/password-link/, a folder Git ignores, and raw check output stays in .git/ha/, which Git does not track. A fictional example, not a real record.
